one_line_answer.text: Assessments can be categorized into two main types: formative and summative.

cites.quote: assessments can be categorized into two main types Formative assessment
Summative assessment

bangla_explanation: Formative assessment training চলার সময় হয়, trainer নিজেই এটা designed করেন।
এর কাজ feedback দিয়ে শেখায় সাহায্য করা, পাস-ফেল করা নয়।
Summative assessment সাধারণত training-এর শেষে হয়, এটাই formal assessment।
এতে ঠিক হয় trainee competent কি না, আর এটা certification-এর জন্য ব্যবহার হয়।

example.en: In an IT course, the trainer gives a quick weekly quiz with feedback. The final competency test leads to a certificate.
example.bn: সাপ্তাহিক quiz হলো formative, শেষের সার্টিফিকেট পরীক্ষা হলো summative।

list_answer.title: Two main types of assessment

items.text: Formative assessment: assists and supports learning with feedback on performance and progress.

cites.quote: This term is used for assessment which assists and supports learning by providing feedback about performance and progress towards the achievement of competency.

items.text: Summative assessment: determines whether a trainee has reached competency, for recognition or certification.

cites.quote: The purpose of this type of assessment is to determine whether a trainee has reached competency
This kind of assessment is used for the purpose of recognition, or certification.

items_bn: Formative — শেখার সময় performance আর অগ্রগতি নিয়ে feedback দিয়ে শেখাকে সাহায্য করে; পাস-ফেলের জন্য নয়।
Summative — trainee competent হয়েছে কি না তা ঠিক করে, যাতে recognition বা certification দেওয়া যায়।

short.prompt: Explain the purpose of formative assessment and summative assessment.
short.modelAnswer:
Formative assessment: assists and supports learning by feedback about performance and progress towards competency. It is conducted during training and designed and conducted by the trainer.
Summative assessment: determines whether a trainee has reached competency or achieved learning outcomes. It is for recognition, classification or certification following a training program.
